# PDF encoding and encryption fixtures

Made by `node test/node/make-pdf-encodings.ts` on 2026-10-31 for D06 T02 §5. Every document is synthetic: Kestrel Bank and Hadeda Couriers are fictional, the account and branch numbers are invented, and each page says "SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT". Ghostscript only produced the files; none of its code is in the repository.

| File                                                     | Generator                                                  | Licence of the generator | What it is                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| -------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `<set>-content.bin`, `<set>-edited.bin`, `<set>-xmp.bin` | Ghostscript 10.06.0 PostScript encode filters              | AGPL-3.0                 | The proof of payment's page content, the same page with its amount changed, and its XMP packet, each encoded for the set's filters: `lzw` (`/LZWDecode`), `a85` (`/ASCII85Decode`), `ahx` (`/ASCIIHexDecode`), `rl` (`/RunLengthDecode`) and `chain` (`[/ASCII85Decode /LZWDecode]`). The tests assemble them into files with the test writer. |
| `lzw-zeros.bin`                                          | Ghostscript 10.06.0 `/LZWEncode`                           | AGPL-3.0                 | 9 MiB of zeros, past one stream's decoding cap                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `rl-zeros.bin`                                           | Ghostscript 10.06.0 `/RunLengthEncode` inside `/LZWEncode` | AGPL-3.0                 | 7.5 MiB of zeros for `[/LZWDecode /RunLengthDecode]`, within one stream's cap, past the total's seven times over                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `rc4-r2.pdf`                                             | Ghostscript 10.06.0 `pdfwrite`                             | AGPL-3.0                 | The POP encrypted with RC4 revision 2 (40-bit), an empty user password, classic layout (every object direct)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `rc4-r3.pdf`                                             | Ghostscript 10.06.0 `pdfwrite`                             | AGPL-3.0                 | The POP encrypted with RC4 revision 3 (128-bit), an empty user password, objects in encrypted object streams                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `rc4-r2-edited.pdf`, `rc4-r3-edited.pdf`                 | Ghostscript, then `appendUpdate`                           | AGPL-3.0, own code       | Each with a later save over its amount, encrypted by the maker under the key the known passwords give                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `rc4-password.pdf`                                       | Ghostscript 10.06.0 `pdfwrite`                             | AGPL-3.0                 | The POP encrypted with RC4 revision 2 and the user password `secret`, which the reader never guesses                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |

Ghostscript writes the XMP metadata stream of an RC4 file unencrypted, which the reader accepts by a marked workaround (`plainXmp` in `src/invoice/pdf.ts`).
